text.tspan: Slow. This permanent is a Generator attuned to the
Circuit: during the Generation Phase, it produces 1
Circuit Point, added to its controller's Circuit resource
pool. Spent: choose a Wormhole with an endpoint at a
Planet you control; place a Directional Restriction
(Section 8.4, which defines Restriction) on it, permitting
travel only from that Planet toward its other endpoint,
The Wrought Assembly builds one design, copied without end, and
needs the line running only one way — everything it makes flows
outward, nothing flows back to interrupt it.
